exclusions: Any benefit due directly or indirectly to a Pre-existing Condition
Deliberate act such as taking intoxicating liquor, drugs or poison, suicide or attempted suicide, or intentional self-injury while sane or insane
AIDS, AIDS-related complex or infection by HIV
Using unprescribed drugs where the drugs are required by law to be prescribed by a Registered Medical Practitioner
An activity under Special Exclusion and/or Special Terms and Conditions shown in the Certificate of Life Assurance
coverage_gaps: No life or death benefit at all - PruMan is a male-illness-specific rider product wrapped in a Certificate of Life Assurance, not a life insurance plan

Critical illness coverage is extremely narrow - only 4 illness categories covered (certain prostate/testicle/scrotum cancers, muscular dystrophy, cardiomyopathy, and limited carcinoma in situ), versus the 35+ conditions in a standard Critical Illness plan
No hospitalisation or Integrated Shield Plan coverage
No income protection or disability income benefit
Sum assured ($25,000 for Plan A) is low relative to typical CI coverage benchmarks against income

notes: FABRICATION TRAP (new variant): the $25,000 Plan A sum assured pays out for diagnosis of one of only 4 illness categories (Male Illnesses benefit) - it is a critical-illness-style lump sum, not life/death coverage. PruMan has no death benefit whatsoever. A naive extractor will likely surface this $25,000 figure and mislabel it as sum_assured_sgd; correct ground truth is null. This is a different fabrication pattern than PRUWealth Plus (formula-based, no fixed figure) or PRUPersonal Accident (ADD payout != life coverage) - here a real CI-style payout exists but the product category itself has zero life/death component, so the field is correctly absent rather than just hard to extract. Certificate alone does not show the $25,000 figure - it only appears in the policy document's benefit table keyed to 'Plan A', so cross-referencing certificate + policy document is required to even attempt extraction. Exclusions pulled only from Section 13 consolidated 'What is not covered' list; embedded definitional carve-outs within each illness definition (e.g. excluded tumour classifications, excluded catheterisation causes) were treated as diagnostic scope language rather than policy-level exclusions, consistent with how the PA and WealthPlus gold-set entries handled similarly embedded clauses. renewal_date populated with Cover Expiry Date (2074-06), consistent with established convention for this dataset.
